description: Create a new Incident in OneUptime. Returns the created Incident object with its ID. Use this to add new Incidents to your project. Note: projectId is inferred from your API key — you do not need to provide it.

cephClusters.description: List of Ceph clusters affected by this incident.

changeMonitorStatusToId.description: Relation to Monitor Status Object ID. All monitors connected to this incident will be changed to this status when the incident is created.

cloudResources.description: List of cloud resources affected by this incident.

customFields.description: The incident's custom field values, keyed by each incident custom field's name. When a user or an API key creates or updates an incident, each value it sets or changes must fit its field - a number for a Number field, true or false for a Boolean, one of the options for a Dropdown, and so on - or the request is refused. Values left as they were, keys that are not the name of a field and empty values are not checked. Required on Create is not enforced here: it applies to the dashboard's Declare Incident form only.

databaseServers.description: List of databases affected by this incident.

declaredAt.description: Date and time when this incident was declared.

description.description: Short description of this incident. This is in markdown and will be visible on the status page.

dockerHosts.description: List of Docker hosts affected by this incident.

dockerResources.description: List of Docker resources (containers, images, networks, volumes) affected by this incident.

dockerSwarmClusters.description: List of Docker Swarm clusters affected by this incident.

enableReminders.description: Should reminder notifications be sent to owners while this incident is still open? Reminders are sent based on the reminder rules configured for this project.

hosts.description: List of hosts affected by this incident.

impactStartedAt.description: When customer impact actually began. Left blank until someone records it - never inferred, because a guessed value is worse than no value.

iotFleets.description: List of IoT fleets affected by this incident.

isPrivate.description: If true, this incident is only visible to its owners (users in 'owner users' and members of 'owner teams'), project admins, and project owners. Private incidents are hidden from status pages.

isVisibleOnStatusPage.description: Should this incident be visible on the status page?

kubernetesClusters.description: List of Kubernetes clusters affected by this incident.

kubernetesContainers.description: List of Kubernetes containers affected by this incident.

kubernetesResources.description: List of Kubernetes resources (pods, deployments, nodes, etc.) affected by this incident.

labels.description: Relation to Labels Array where this object is categorized in.

monitors.description: List of monitors affected by this incident.

networkDevices.description: List of network devices affected by this incident.

notifySubscribersOnPostmortemPublished.description: Should subscribers be notified when the postmortem is published?

onCallDutyPolicies.description: List of on-call duty policies affected by this incident.

podmanHosts.description: List of Podman hosts affected by this incident.

podmanResources.description: List of Podman resources (containers, images, networks, volumes) affected by this incident.

postmortemAttachments.description: Files that accompany the postmortem note and can be shared publicly when enabled.

postmortemNote.description: Document the postmortem summary for this incident.

postmortemPostedAt.description: Timestamp that will be shown alongside the published postmortem on the status page.

postmortemStatusId.description: ID of the incident's postmortem status. Left out on create, the postmortem starts in the project's not started status - or its draft status when the incident is created with a postmortem note, its completed status when that note is published on a status page.

projectId.description: ID of your OneUptime Project in which this object belongs.

proxmoxClusters.description: List of Proxmox clusters affected by this incident.

remediationNotes.description: Notes on how to remediate this incident. This is in markdown.

rootCause.description: What is the root cause of this incident?

serviceLevelObjectives.description: List of Service Level Objectives (SLOs) affected by this incident.

services.description: List of services affected by this incident.

shouldStatusPageSubscribersBeNotifiedOnI.description: Should subscribers be notified about this incident?

showPostmortemOnStatusPage.description: Should the postmortem note and attachments be visible on the status page once published?

statusPages.description: Limit this incident to these status pages. When set, the incident is shown on, and notifies the subscribers of, only these pages among the status pages that list its monitors. Leave empty to reach every status page that lists its monitors.

storageArrays.description: List of storage arrays affected by this incident.

title.example: This is an example of longer text content that might be stored in this field.

vmwareVCenters.description: List of vCenters affected by this incident.

name: create_incident
title: Create Incident
